query: Which vendors offer a disaggregated all-flash storage acceleration appliance for AI inference and training?
response:
As of 2024, **there are no widely recognized, commercially available “disaggregated all-flash storage acceleration appliances” specifically branded and optimized *exclusively* for AI inference and training** — at least not in the way the term might imply (e.g., a standalone hardware appliance that sits between compute and storage, offering disaggregated flash + AI-aware acceleration). However, several vendors offer **high-performance, disaggregated (or disaggregation-ready), all-flash storage systems with AI/ML-optimized features**, often deployed *in support of* AI training and inference workloads. These solutions emphasize: - Ultra-low latency & high IOPS/throughput (for data loading bottlenecks), - NVMe-oF (NVMe over Fabrics) or RDMA-based disaggregation, - AI-aware software (e.g., prefetching, data layout optimization, integration with ML frameworks like PyTorch/TensorFlow), - Support for object/file/NVMe-native access, often with GPU-direct storage capabilities. • All-flash, NVMe-based, built-in erasure coding & compression
• Native object + file + block; supports GPU-direct storage via GPUDirect Storage (GDS)
• Used by AI labs (e.g., NVIDIA DGX Cloud, CoreWeave) for large-scale training datasets | | **Pure Storage** | FlashBlade//S (with Purity//FA & File) + Evergreen//One | • All-flash scale-out NAS (NFS/SMB/S3) with sub-millisecond latency
• NVMe-oF support; integrates with NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage
• AI Data Services (e.g., dataset versioning, snapshot-based data pipelines)
• Deployed in AI clusters (e.g., Meta, OpenAI partners, HPE GreenLake for AI) | | **DDN (DataDirect Networks)** | EXAScaler® ES7900 / A³I (AI & Analytics Infrastructure) | • All-flash parallel file system (EXAScaler) optimized for HPC/AI
• Supports NVMe-oF, RDMA, and GPU-Direct Storage
• Designed for massive concurrent reads/writes (e.g., billion-image datasets)
